intro.description2: a web developer passionate about creating modern, sustainable, accessible, and efficient websites. I enjoy working with JavaScript, React, SQL, and Python.

project1.title: The SUPER Assessor
project1.summary: Developed for the full-stack web development course, this project was created with 2 other students. The application helps teachers create and evaluate assessment forms using a card-based game. Built using the MERN stack.
achievements: Designed and implemented a REST API using Node.js and Express.
Built the frontend using React for a responsive UI.
Implemented JWT-based authentication for secure login and session management.
Developed a PDF generation feature for exporting assessment forms.
learnings: Gained hands-on experience working with the MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) stack.
Better understanding of API design and data flow between frontend and backend.
Learned how to design a scalable and secure authentication system using tokens.
Learned about team collaboration using GitHub for version control and Agile principles.

project2.title: Travel Website with a Focus on Accessibility
project2.summary: For an accessibility, usability, and ethics course, I built a travel-themed website that prioritizes inclusive design. The goal was to ensure that users with various disabilities could navigate and interact with the site easily, following WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines).
achievements: Designed and implemented a fully accessible website following WCAG 2.1 guidelines.
Used ARIA attributes to improve screen reader support for visually impaired users.
Ensured full keyboard navigation to support users with motor disabilities.
Optimized color contrast, typography, and interactive elements for usability.
learnings: Gained deeper knowledge of web accessibility principles and assistive technologies.
Learned how to test websites using screen readers and keyboard navigation.
Strengthened skills in inclusive UI/UX design.
Understood the ethical implications of digital accessibility and inclusion.

project3.title: TryggTur – Improving Winter Safety in Gjøvik
project3.summary: For a health service design course, I collaborated with two other students to develop TryggTur, a platform that helps citizens report and track sidewalk clearing efforts during winter. Users can request snow removal, subscribe to alerts, and contribute to safer walking and cycling conditions.
achievements: Developed a user-friendly interface that allows residents to report uncleared sidewalks.
Implemented a real-time notification system to inform users when sidewalks are cleared or gritted.
Integrated an interactive map for users to track service requests and maintenance updates.
Designed and optimized the platform for both desktop and mobile users.
learnings: Learned how to apply user-centered design principles in a real-world problem.
Gained experience in designing interactive maps and integrating live data updates.
Developed a deeper understanding of how technology can improve public safety services.
Enhanced teamwork and communication skills while collaborating with stakeholders.

about.description1: I am a developer and a designer who has studied web development at NTNU Gjøvik for the past 3 years. I will graduate with a bachelor's degree in 2025.
about.description2: I am 23 years old and come from Bødalen in Asker. Technology and coding have always been a passion of mine. In 2022, I started studying web development at NTNU and quickly realized that this was something I really wanted to work with. I enjoy learning new things and challenging myself. It is also important for me to stay active and I spend a lot of time at the gym. In addition, I love to travel and experience new places and cultures.
